compute_local_shape: compute the local shard shape of a DTensor given its global shape, device mesh, and placements
compute_local_shape_and_global_offset: compute the local tensor shape and global offsets of a DTensor for checkpointing
compute_global_tensor_info: compute the global size and stride of a DTensor from its local tensor and placements
try_find_mesh_from_args: find the device mesh object from function arguments containing DTensor or DTensorSpec objects
test_compute_local_shape: test the compute_local_shape function with a global shape, device mesh, and shard placements
